phase: 16 deterministic-random paired development cells x two purchase seeds = 32. Same v18 plans/quotes; two citizens per mechanism, both arms. No untouched confirmation claim.
primary: All 32 financial/quote checks must pass. Deterministic unique-zero outcomes are disclosed, not model successes. Inspect raw reasons. No incomplete matched contrasts, no pick-best or silent retries.
selection: Generic typed ordered purchase protocol with 1024-token reasoning and an opt-in exact unique-choice bypass. Prompt, representation and budget differ jointly from v1; no single-cause attribution and no selection by policy effect sizes.
conditions: Hypothetical item prices fixed before output; not inferred from individual daily expenditure.
Hypothetical merchant participation and personal eligibility; exact age/card history not observed.
Explicit zero is allowed. Free schedule activities cannot be routed to a merchant.
Own cash, grant balance and prepaid asset acquisition separate; future rebate not current money.
Fixed one-day upstream schedules, missing inventory/needs/income path; this is not total daily demand validation.
Two purchase seeds share frozen upstream plans. Candidate selection did not use current v1 response values; seeded citizen sample fixed before v2 calls.
interpretation: Report all paired nominal consumption, funding and asset acquisition contrasts regardless of direction. These are conditional synthetic scenario outputs, never comparisons to historical empirical magnitudes or significance.
